verdict.rationale: Sentry's pricing tiers list custom dashboards (10 on Free, 20 on Team, unlimited on higher plans), so the product has its own dashboarding capability. Releases tracking is also documented, and a community user credits historical error data. However, nothing in the evidence describes what these dashboards show for error trends. Missing for 10: documented cross-project/team error trend widgets, top-regression views, new-issues-per-release reporting, volume-over-time charts, and independent corroboration of dashboard use by engineering leaders.
